scenarios.name: Dock left from an expanded Modify title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user chooses Left from Docking Positions on its title
the ribbon is docked on the left
the Modify additional command area closes
the user opens Docking Positions from the left-docked ribbon
the ribbon returns to the top with the additional command area closed
